Hi — I'm the founder of Peak Brew Coffee, a specialty DTC coffee brand. We sell drip bags and freshly roasted single-origin beans through our Shopify store (we use Recharge for subscriptions, and we don't currently have a loyalty app set up). Our churn after the first renewal is really hurting us and we want to launch a proper monthly discovery program for our customers — something curated, with some kind of surprise element for loyal subscribers.

I need a full written plan for this. Please generate it as a Markdown file called `taster_box_plan.md`. The plan should cover everything we need: what goes in the box and how we rotate it, exactly how and when we give surprise gifts (with rules so we don't overpromise), what the subscriber experience looks and feels like end-to-end, how ops should handle substitutions when stock is tight, and how we'll know if any of this is working — including a phased rollout timeline.

We have some limited single-origin lots we'd love to use, and our audience skews toward educated home brewers. Budget is mid-range. Please make this detailed enough that our team can actually implement it.
